/*common.coco."getCategoryTreeRootSelect"*/
SELECT STD_CATEG_ID, CATEG_NAME, CATEG_SYS_CODE, CATEG_TYPE, PID, DEPTH, CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer}) AND PID IN (SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer}) AND PID IS NULL ) ORDER BY CATEG_SYS_CODE ASC,PID ASC

SELECT STD_CATEG_ID, CATEG_NAME, CATEG_SYS_CODE, CATEG_TYPE, PID, DEPTH, CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer}) AND PID = #{st_category_id} ORDER BY CATEG_SYS_CODE ASC,PID ASC
